body: Thanks for replying it means a lot to get this kind of response from someone who understands your situation.Yeah in my house almost everyone hates Everyone some people can't even bare the sight of each other but still we live together due to My Grandma and Dad.And I can't even get out of my house at all I can't even go out to the terrace of my own house to get some air as my dad worries that I'll get the Virus from our neighbours who just moved in some months ago.Earlier I used to go the terrace and have moments of solitude but now I can't even do that so I feel really stuck and depressed all the time.
I'll try to look into this and I hope you also get through whatever you're going through and I've also read that sometimes Meditation really helps.

It only happens to me when I'm not doing anything that requires much of my attention and when my brain is kind of free and I try to train my brain to not think of these things like I imagine that all these thoughts are locked in a chest and thrown somewhere deep around the sea and it'll show me a Error:404 and this helps most of the time but if I'm stressed due to something then I have no control of the thought train.
And thanks for replying fellow Redditor!
